note.en: Use direct summation with the same 2D logarithmic kernel and particles to check expansion order, hierarchical translations and force error. Do not reuse a 3D 1/r reference. The companion uses Cartesian direct sums and analytic configurations as separate references, varying expansion order and tree depth independently. It guarantees neither monotonic error with depth nor accuracy/complexity for a 3D Coulomb kernel.
